title: Add rate limiting and input validation with Zod schemas
acceptance_criteria: Zod schemas defined for every API route input (body, params, query)
Rate limiting middleware created using in-memory sliding window (upgradable to Redis)
Default rate limit: 30 requests/minute per authenticated user, 10/minute per IP for unauthenticated
Rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-*) returned in all API responses
Zod validation errors return structured 400 responses with field-level messages
Rate limit exceeded returns 429 with Retry-After header
